'''Jyl Korlis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sathari/Legends|Sathari]] and a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Quolas]] on [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]].

==Biography==
A citizen of the city of [[Quolas]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arbooine/Legends|Arbooine]], Jyl Korlis was a [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]] farmer who grew and cultivated the enormous mushrooms native to the world and grown on the exterior of the [[elrit tree]] which housed the city. In the years leading up to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Reeve]] [[Gel Marcolf]] began to raise rates and tax the farming industry extensively by requiring them tithe a greater portion of the harvest as payment.

Keeping the cream of the crop for his own home, Marcolf struck deep into Korlis' profits and further insulted her by peddling her wares outside of the city for an increased rate. As her warehouse was largely empty, Korlis began to rent out her empty facility to travelers as an inn. While not a member of either the [[Helshar clan|Helshar]] or [[Tumris clan]], Korlis' was sympathetic to the [[Quolas resistance|resistance movement]] brewing against the unlawful reign of Reeve Marcolf.
